[[File:Vitaly_Fridzon_7_PBC_CSKA_Moscow_20171027.jpg|thumb|[[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA]] players [[Vitaly Fridzon]] and [[Léo Westermann]]]]

'''Moscow Basketball Derby''' is the name given to professional [[basketball]] games between [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]] of [[Moscow]], and [[BC Khimki|Khimki Moscow Region]], from [[Khimki]] in [[Moscow Oblast]].{{Refn|[http://sportmedia.news/news/sobytiya/basketbolnoe-derbi-tsska-himki/ Баскетбольное дерби «ЦСКА» — «Химки»]}}{{Refn|[https://news.sputnik.ru/sport/c214b7e6c0bc17bd6159ff5cc5f3b105728a5846 Никита Курбанов: "Матчи ЦСКА и "Химок" стали настоящим дерби"]}}{{Refn|[https://tech2.org/belarus/cska-and-khimki-will-play-in-the-russian-euroleague-derby-basketball-euro-cup-news-basketball/ CSKA and Khimki will play in the Russian Euroleague derby]}}{{Refn|[https://matchtv.ru/basketball/liga_vtb/matchtvvideo_NI797189_clip_Glavnoje_protivostojanije_rossijskogo_basketbola Главное противостояние российского баскетбола], [[Match TV]]}}{{Refn|[https://www.sovsport.ru/basketball/news/851012-dimitris-itudis-himki-ostajutsja-glavnym-sopernikom-cska-v-rossii Димитрис Итудис: «Химки» остаются главным соперником ЦСКА в России]}}

It is considered to be the biggest [[local derby|rivalry]] in Russian basketball.{{Refn|[https://matchtv.ru/basketball/matchtvnews_NI731397_CSKA_unichtozhajet_Khimki ЦСКА уничтожает «Химки»]}}{{Refn|[https://sport.rambler.ru/other/38350249-tsska-pobedil-himki-v-glavnom-derbi-rossiyskogo-basketbola/ ЦСКА победил «Химки» в главном дерби российского баскетбола]}} Until 2016, there was also a third Moscow-based basketball club, [[MBC Dynamo Moscow|Dynamo Moscow]], which had an even bigger local derby with CSKA, as the two teams were from Moscow city itself. However, the Dynamo Moscow club folded in 2016.
